name: vscode-copilot-bridge
description: Expose VS Code's Language Model API to an authenticated localhost CLI.

languageModelTools.name: bridge_replaceString
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace one exact literal string in a file. The oldString must appear exactly once; include surrounding lines to make it unique, or pass replaceAll: true to replace every occurrence (e.g. a rename). On success the result shows the edited region with line numbers, so there is no need to read the file again to verify. On failure the result shows the file's actual lines; reuse them verbatim as oldString. Paths must be absolute and inside the open workspace. Use this instead of copilot_replaceString or copilot_applyPatch, which do not work outside VS Code's own chat.

filePath.description: The absolute path to the file to edit.

oldString.description: The exact literal text to replace. Must occur exactly once in the file.

newString.description: The text to write in its place. Pass an empty string to delete.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence of oldString instead of requiring exactly one. Default false.

languageModelTools.name: bridge_createFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Write a file with the given content, creating it if needed. An existing file is replaced whole, so use bridge_replaceString for partial edits. Paths must be absolute and inside the open workspace. Use this instead of copilot_createFile, which does not work outside VS Code's own chat.

filePath.description: The absolute path to the file to write.

content.description: The full content of the file.
